dispositions.topic_text: Identity and relationship of the service's deployment route
dispositions.what: Whether the deliverer's deployment route shares its implementation with the Client Portal's: State 2 decides only that rule 2's check runs before each deployment; the Factory route (deploy/release.sh with the deliverer's advisory policy) is the deployment's.

dispositions.topic_text: Failure conditions and required outcomes when the dependency check cannot complete
dispositions.what: Which inventory, snapshot, metadata or evaluation failures leave the check incomplete, and the not_checked verdict each gives: rule 2 leaves the check and its age limit to the deployment route.

dispositions.topic_text: Required test coverage for snapshot acceptance and complete distribution inventory
dispositions.what: Tests that a stale or unaccepted OSV snapshot cannot admit an image and that every installed distribution is enumerated: the deployment route's own tests (dependency advisories), not a State 2 witness.

dispositions.topic_text: Whether all deployments must use the named route and how bypasses are prevented
dispositions.reason: No text names another deployment mechanism or an actor who may use one; rule 2 requires the check before each deployment, so there is nothing to bypass in State 2.

dispositions.topic_text: Required test coverage for vulnerability prevention and deployment-route bypasses
dispositions.reason: As T2: no deployment path outside the route exists in the texts; INV-15's witness is the route refusing the two cases rule 2 names.
